title: Welcome to Blackwater
text: Welcome to Blackwater, kid. Before you make a move, know where you stand. Your cash, vitals, and operation timer are right here. Keep an eye on your power, too. A name in this city takes work.

title: Learn your city
text: This is your city. Select a district on the map to see what is happening there. Look over the properties, the businesses, and the local heat before you make your move.

title: Start small
text: Everybody starts somewhere. Bin diving is one way to look for your first useful finds. Read the costs, chances, and cooldown before you search. Even a small find can be the start of something.

title: Know what you carry
text: Your inventory tells you what you own, and where it is. Check your carried goods, equipment, and stored stock. Before you buy or sell, make sure you know what is available.

title: Give your operation room
text: Now, warehouses. Open View Plots in a district, then look for garages and warehouses. Check the capacity, the lease terms, and the cost. Once you have access to storage, use your inventory to manage the goods you keep there. No need to spend anything during this tour.

title: Make your money
text: You have options. Find a job, explore the resource district, or learn the player market. Check the requirements and rewards first. Start with a move you understand, then build from there.

title: Money and connections
text: Take a look at the bank when you are ready to manage your money. Gangs and telegrams help you meet the people behind the city. Read the terms and message fees before you commit. Good connections begin with a little patience.

title: Your first move
text: That is the introduction. Start with bin diving, take a closer look at the city, or check your inventory. The choice is yours. You can replay this tour from the dashboard whenever you need a reminder. Welcome to Blackwater.
